capabilities.name: splunk.indexes.read
capabilities.description: Read the bounded catalogue of indexes visible to the selected Splunk environment.

capabilities.name: splunk.internal.errors.read
capabilities.description: Read a bounded aggregate of recent Splunk internal errors by host and component.

argument_bindings.fixed_value: index=_internal earliest=-15m latest=now log_level=ERROR | stats count by host component | sort - count | head 50

capabilities.name: splunk.index.activity.count
capabilities.description: Count events in one exact Splunk index over the fixed recent fifteen-minute window.

argument_bindings.value_template: index={index_name} earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count
index={index_name} earliest=-15m latest=now | stats count

capabilities.name: splunk.index.errors.read
capabilities.description: Read bounded aggregate error indicators for one exact Splunk index over the fixed recent fifteen-minute window.

argument_bindings.value_template: index={index_name} earliest=-15m latest=now ("ERROR" OR "Exception" OR "failed") | stats count by host sourcetype | sort - count | head 50
index={index_name} earliest=-15m latest=now ("ERROR" OR "Exception" OR "failed") | stats count by host sourcetype | sort - count | head 50

capabilities.name: splunk.pod.logs.read
capabilities.description: Read up to 30 short log excerpts for an exact pod in the tenant index named by its namespace, retaining cluster and container hints for verification.

argument_bindings.value_template: index="{namespace}" earliest=-{window} latest=now | eval cluster_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.cluster_name','kubernetes.cluster.name',cluster_name,"unknown"), pod_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name','kubernetes.pod.name',pod_name,pod,"unknown"), container_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name','kubernetes.container.name',container_name,"unknown"), pod_uid_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_id','kubernetes.pod_uid',pod_uid,"unknown") | where pod_hint="{pod_name}" | head 30 | eval log_excerpt=substr(_raw,1,600) | table _time _indextime cluster_hint pod_hint pod_uid_hint container_hint host source sourcetype log_excerpt
-{window}

capabilities.name: splunk.pod.errors.read
capabilities.description: Read up to 30 candidate error excerpts for an exact pod in its namespace index using a fixed keyword heuristic, not an exhaustive severity classification.

argument_bindings.value_template: index="{namespace}" earliest=-{window} latest=now | eval cluster_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.cluster_name','kubernetes.cluster.name',cluster_name,"unknown"), pod_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name','kubernetes.pod.name',pod_name,pod,"unknown"), container_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name','kubernetes.container.name',container_name,"unknown"), pod_uid_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_id','kubernetes.pod_uid',pod_uid,"unknown") | where pod_hint="{pod_name}" | where match(lower(_raw),"error|exception|fatal|panic|timeout|timed out|connection refused|failed") | head 30 | eval log_excerpt=substr(_raw,1,600) | table _time _indextime cluster_hint pod_hint pod_uid_hint container_hint host source sourcetype log_excerpt
-{window}

capabilities.name: splunk.index.ingestion.read
capabilities.description: Summarise event count, event-time coverage, indexing timestamps and observed indexing delay within one namespace index and recent window; group by observed cluster hint.

argument_bindings.value_template: index="{namespace}" earliest=-{window} latest=now | eval cluster_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.cluster_name','kubernetes.cluster.name',cluster_name,"unknown"), pod_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name','kubernetes.pod.name',pod_name,pod,"unknown"), container_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name','kubernetes.container.name',container_name,"unknown"), pod_uid_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_id','kubernetes.pod_uid',pod_uid,"unknown") | eval observed_delay_seconds=_indextime-_time | stats count AS event_count min(_time) AS first_event_time max(_time) AS last_event_time max(_indextime) AS last_index_time max(observed_delay_seconds) AS maximum_observed_delay_seconds by cluster_hint | head 30
-{window}

capabilities.name: splunk.index.sources.read
capabilities.description: Read up to 30 leading source groups within one namespace index, preserving observed cluster hints rather than claiming cluster isolation.

argument_bindings.value_template: index="{namespace}" earliest=-{window} latest=now | eval cluster_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.cluster_name','kubernetes.cluster.name',cluster_name,"unknown"), pod_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name','kubernetes.pod.name',pod_name,pod,"unknown"), container_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name','kubernetes.container.name',container_name,"unknown"), pod_uid_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_id','kubernetes.pod_uid',pod_uid,"unknown") | stats count AS event_count by cluster_hint host source sourcetype | sort 30 - event_count
-{window}

capabilities.name: splunk.request.trace.read
capabilities.description: Read up to 30 short excerpts matching one exact correlation, request or trace identifier in a namespace index; returned cluster hints must be verified.

argument_bindings.value_template: index="{namespace}" earliest=-{window} latest=now | eval cluster_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.cluster_name','kubernetes.cluster.name',cluster_name,"unknown"), pod_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name','kubernetes.pod.name',pod_name,pod,"unknown"), container_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name','kubernetes.container.name',container_name,"unknown"), pod_uid_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_id','kubernetes.pod_uid',pod_uid,"unknown") | where correlation_id="{request_id}" OR request_id="{request_id}" OR trace_id="{request_id}" OR 'trace.id'="{request_id}" | head 30 | eval log_excerpt=substr(_raw,1,600) | table _time _indextime cluster_hint pod_hint pod_uid_hint container_hint host source sourcetype log_excerpt
-{window}

capabilities.name: splunk.index.volume.read
capabilities.description: Read five-minute event-count buckets for one namespace index, grouped by observed cluster hint; counts are not byte volume or licence consumption.

argument_bindings.value_template: index="{namespace}" earliest=-{window} latest=now | eval cluster_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.cluster_name','kubernetes.cluster.name',cluster_name,"unknown"), pod_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_name','kubernetes.pod.name',pod_name,pod,"unknown"), container_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.container_name','kubernetes.container.name',container_name,"unknown"), pod_uid_hint=coalesce('kubernetes.pod_id','kubernetes.pod_uid',pod_uid,"unknown") | bin _time span=5m | stats count AS event_count by _time cluster_hint | sort 0 _time cluster_hint | head 30
-{window}
